THE PERSON BEHIND THE RECORDS.
03 / BEHIND THE BOOTH

Rooted in house.
Always moving.

Toronto-born. Montréal-based. Peter Damian connects deep house, house and electronic music with an instinct for the room.

His music has appeared on Cr2, Plaza and Bunny Tiger. Behind the decks, his journey has taken him across Canada, the USA, the UK, Greece and Croatia.

Explore the releases, get lost in a mix, or follow along for the next night out.
